aboutDevice.heading: About Device
aboutDevice.description: Device identity, network addresses, and system information.
aboutDevice.aboutQManagerDescription: Modem management interface for Quectel modems.
aboutDevice.aboutQManagerBody: Hey there! Rus here. QManager is the latest iteration of QuecManager, built with a newer and more reliable approach compared to its predecessor — while still combining technical settings for advanced users with a simplified UI for those just getting started. QManager promises to deliver the same features QuecManager had, only better, more reliable, and more user-friendly. Special thanks to iamromulan, clndwhr, and Wutang Clan! If you like this project, any kind of support is much appreciated. Thanks!
